prefabs.description: A small air defense site with 2 ZSU guns, sandbags and a supply truck.

prefabs.name: Artillery Base
prefabs.author: Bug Smasher Pilot (hgoc)
prefabs.description: Artillery base/outpost. Fortified by short range SAMs. You can spawn it in a fixed position on the Syria map, but it should also work in any location.

prefabs.name: Carrier - Blank CSG 73
prefabs.author: Shuffle
prefabs.description: Carrier Strike Group with CVN 73, 2x Burkes, 1x Tico, 1x Perry, 1x Tilde Logistics. On deck and launching are CSAR HH-60, E2-D and S-3B, delayed A-6E. UH60 is used for model quality purposes. Switch it out to low poly HH60 if it bothers you. Deck is deliberately left clear for use with RedKites Carrier Deck scripts, but you can add your own statics if you wish.

prefabs.author: TheProperGrip
prefabs.description: Loosely based on public recon images from the 2021 in the buildup prior to the invasion of Ukraine. Infantry and patrolling vehicles are actual units, everything else should be static.

prefabs.author: Bug Smasher Pilot (hgoc)

prefabs.name: Truck Depot Complete
prefabs.author: nihprodne
prefabs.description: A Cold War-era truck depot and logistics base for the Caucasus: supply and fuel trucks, cargo containers, ammo pallets and fuel barrels around an outpost, command center and buildings, all ringed with sandbag emplacements and light air defenses (ZU-23, ZSU-23-4 Shilka, DShK) plus a few infantry. Not tied to a fixed position, so you can drop it anywhere.
